item.subject: science
item.stem:
Falguni sorts picture cards for a class display in Bhopal. One card shows a rocky asteroid orbiting between Mars and Jupiter; another shows the bright star Sirius far beyond the planets.

Which choice correctly places the objects and how they get light?

options.A: Both the asteroid and Sirius belong to the Solar System and both shine by making their own light.
options.B: The asteroid belongs to the Solar System and shines by reflecting sunlight; Sirius is outside the Solar System and shines with its own light.
options.C: Only the Sun and the eight planets belong to the Solar System, so the asteroid is excluded.
options.D: Sirius belongs to the Solar System because it looks very bright from Earth.
